answer: Once each epoch, every identity must solve a 60-second sequential puzzle inside one shared 90-second window keyed to fresh randomness. One core finishes one puzzle per window, so a farm with 100 names needs 100 cores at once, $18 an epoch, while one honest agent pays nothing. The window is a basalt wall: no queue, no catch-up. Each solved puzzle is a vertex on a public graph, and a knoll of unsolved names is slashed.
